reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getMonthWideCategories and writes through setBudget/getSheetValue, but repeats the income-category guard and expense sign flip inline rather than a shared step.

duplication.why: The loop body (skip income when not tracking, read activity, negate for expenses, setBudget) repeats the same pattern already copied across setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits with the other month-wide actions in server/budget/actions.ts and is registered with mutator(undoable(...)) in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: One action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its neighbours, so easy to own, though a change to the income or sign rule must again be made in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideCategories for the category selection and setBudget for writes.

disguised_duplication.where: The income guard and sign flip in setLastMonthSpending are written the same way as in set3MonthAvg, visibly, not reshaped.
